description: Cover shot from the top of the page: the glowing VICE NIGHT HIGHWAY roadside sign, neon-road progress with grade counts, the full dash-panel control row (search, kind / grade / state filters, spoiler shield, Export / Import), several trophies earned, and the Cunning Stunts guide open in the detail panel.
Roadmap to the Platinum: the first stages with their trophies and MISSABLE WATCH flags.
Guide detail for The Shootist (silver): official description, target counter at 30 of 42 range challenges, the guide in our own words and its sources line.
Spoiler shield ON (toggle visible in the control row) with the Collectibles filter applied: story trophy names and descriptions are masked in the detail panel until earned.
